about: Surrey is a large municipality in Metro Vancouver, south of the Fraser River toward the U.S. border. It is one of B.C.’s fastest-growing cities, with town centres in City Centre, Guildford, Newton, Cloverdale, and South Surrey. Agriculture still occupies parts of the south and east. About 570,000 people live in Surrey.
seoSummary: Fast-growing Metro Vancouver city south of the Fraser, with several town centres.
knownFor: Rapid growth and a SkyTrain city centre
Fraser Valley agriculture on the city’s edge
Crescent Beach and the Boundary Bay shore
